gitCommit.subject: CI: the secret scan's known false positives — 9 test idempotency keys in the dukan-portal evidence on ci-evidence
gitCommit.body:
CI: the secret scan's known false positives — 9 test idempotency keys in the dukan-portal evidence on ci-evidence

The full-history scan reads every branch. The dukan-portal CI committed browser evidence (portal-claim-{en,fr,ar}.json)
carrying the test's generated idempotencyKey, which gitleaks' generic-api-key rule matches, so every branch's CI has
failed since 2026-10-18 11:52Z. Reproduced with CI's image (sha256:c00b6bd0…) on a full clone: 9 leaks without this
file, none with it. No file of the site changes.
